body.zh: KPI仍用17日19:00NPT图报：尼方1410死、6145失联、13756获救。SitRep#16 PDF未见。中方截至9月5日18时43/519/2。口岸关闭，堰塞湖已排空。勿把中尼数字相加。
body.en: KPI still 17 Sep 19:00 NPT graphic: NP 1,410 dead / 6,145 missing / 13,756 rescued. SitRep #16 PDF not posted. CN 43/519/2 as of 5 Sep 18:00. Gate closed; lake drained. Do not add CN+NP.
